text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Opposition parties known as Koutla comes first in local council elections with 7,686 seats out of 24,253.
- Morocco seeks ways to involve its expatriates in its privatisation programme. Expatriates remittances are the country's first currency earner ahead of phosphates exports and tourism.
- Morocco to start a 1.5 billion dirhams ($159.5 million) development programme in its northern provinces.
- Former Zairean President Mobutu Sese Seko in Tangier for medical treatment. ($1 = 9.4 dirhams)
